sources.title: nkthebass/tinybrainbot-100m-v3-instruct · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 100M-parameter chat/instruct model that beats SupraLabs/Supra2-100M-Instruct on 6/7 benchmarks on the official EleutherAI LM-Eval Harness — and actually converses.

sources.title: nkthebass/tinybrainbot-100m-v3-math · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 100M-parameter math/reasoning specialist, SFT'd from tinybrainbot-100m-v3-base on a math-heavy diet (order-of-operations, word problems, chain-of-thought). Beats Supra2-100M-Instruct on 5/7 benchmarks on the official EleutherAI LM-Eval Harness.
